name: Isometric infographic
reads_as: A clean isometric infographic of a working system: flat three-tone solids at true 30 degree isometric on a floating diorama board with strata at its edges, a pale cool ground, no outlines on solids and thin slate ink only for the infographic furniture (map-pin labels on leaders, routes, cut lines, rings, legends). One reserved vermilion marks the subject; four legend hues and named materials keep one meaning each. Numbers are drawn as Isotype units that add up. Two registers: calm teaching boards (a few plates and stations, iso bars, a three-step flow, side notes) for explaining, and a dense diorama (cutaways, a tracked subject with a you-are-here ring, a circular inset, focus and context, routes with moving things, a scale reveal) where a system must be seen working. For corporate adults: operations, supply chains, data centres, cloud architecture, sites and buildings, processes.
avoid_for: abstract ideas with no place or system

shape._note: Solids are drawn by the isometric engine (runtime/engines/isometric.js) in three tones from one token, with no outline; `stroke` is the ink line weight of the infographic furniture (leaders, routes, cut lines, rings). Cards and plates beside the board are flat white with no shadow: the board's own cast shadows are the only shadows in a frame (one light, one shadow type).

ambient._note: the board carries its own faint isometric lattice (drawn by the engine inside the board, so it moves with the camera); the ground stays a calm flat field

captions._active_note: the spoken word in a deep vermilion (the subject hue's dark tone), 5.5:1 on the pale map-label pill

characters._extras_note: what a background person is (D-100): on an isometric board people are flat Isotype pictograms drawn by the engine (no faces); a designed character kit (Claude Design first, skills/lnd/lnd-character-design) is needed for anyone the story follows as a person. Background extras outside the board are silhouettes.

join_note: One board, one camera: pan, zoom and inset within a board inside a topic (continue); a cut to a second board for before and after, here and there, or a new system; a wipe only at a section change.

fx._note: no background shader: the pale field is calm and the board brings its own lattice. A very light vignette sits the board in the middle. Grain off (D-100).

pace._why: a board is a busy picture by nature: the engine's density limits (docs/styles/engines/isometric.md) keep the teaching register calm
